sections.text:
BioIntel Demo
Rare_Disease reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 7. The compound ivacaftor was discussed with target CFTR in the context of cystic fibrosis. The example mutation is G551D. A demonstration EC50 measurement of 536 nM is shown for Homo sapiens. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0007 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0007.
